technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, OBV, CMF) show bullish structure with three white soldiers pattern, but price remains below key moving averages (EMA50, EMA200, SMA200) and Ichimoku cloud, indicating weak intermediate trend alignment and limited swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: NEM shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures multinational commodities exporters like NEM, with earnings binary event in 29 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, three white soldiers, OBV/CMF bullish, supertrend/PSAR confirmation) with extreme fear sentiment (17/100) creates contrarian entry near support (37.72) ahead of potential relief bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA50/200, SMA200), Ichimoku cloud, and VWAP in severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong USD), with zero fundamental support, no strategy triggers, and binary earnings risk in 29 days negating swing trade thesis.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, three white soldiers, OBV/CMF bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (17/100) offers contrarian appeal at support (37.72). However, price remains trapped below all major moving averages (EMA50/200, SMA200) and Ichimoku cloud in severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong USD), negating swing trade thesis.
decision.primary_risk: Binary earnings event in 29 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (322.4) creates execution risk that outweighs short-term momentum; macro environment remains unfavourable for commodity exporters.
